capabilities: Pull new group chat messages into a vault-relative Markdown inbox note via ribbon icon or command palette command
Filter system messages and keep local sync state to prevent duplicate imports
Configure a user-owned Feishu/Lark custom app with App ID, App Secret, Chat ID and target file
List chats visible to the app to help find the group Chat ID
Follow a built-in setup guide for creating and publishing the Feishu custom app and bot
extras: README warns the App Secret is stored in local plugin data, so the vault's .obsidian configuration must not be published; setup steps are also available as a built-in guide in the plugin settings.
motivation: The README frames using Feishu/Lark on a phone as a lightweight capture inbox with one-button pull into Obsidian, implying the author wanted mobile capture without leaving that chat app.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull quick notes captured in Feishu/Lark chat messages on a phone into a local note.

requires.name: user-created Feishu/Lark custom app App ID and App Secret

summary: Integration that syncs messages from a Feishu/Lark group chat into a vault Markdown file, using the chat as a mobile quick-capture inbox.
